nodes.label: Trim & season chicken
nodes.description: Trim excess fat off the chicken thighs and season with salt & pepper.

nodes.label: Dice onion, carrot & celery
nodes.description: Dice the mirepoix — onion, carrot, and celery — into small even pieces.

nodes.label: Mince garlic
nodes.description: Mince the garlic cloves.

nodes.label: Measure stock, bay leaf & thyme
nodes.description: Measure out the stock and set aside the bay leaf and thyme.

nodes.label: Sauté onion, carrot & celery
nodes.description: Sweat the mirepoix and garlic in the pot until softened.

nodes.label: Add chicken & stock, simmer
nodes.description: Add the chicken, stock, bay leaf and thyme; simmer until the chicken is cooked through.

nodes.label: Shred the cooked chicken
nodes.description: Pull the chicken out, shred with two forks, discard the bay leaf.

nodes.label: Cook egg noodles in the broth
nodes.description: Bring the broth back to a simmer and cook the egg noodles directly in it.

nodes.label: Return chicken & garnish with parsley
nodes.description: Stir the shredded chicken back in, adjust seasoning, and finish with chopped parsley.

nodes.label: Ladle & serve hot
nodes.description: Ladle into bowls and serve immediately while hot.

nodes.label: Cut tofu into cubes
nodes.description: Drain the block, cut into ~2cm cubes.

nodes.label: Mince garlic
nodes.description: Mince the garlic cloves.

nodes.label: Portion & season ground pork
nodes.description: Portion the ground pork, season lightly with shaoxing wine.

nodes.label: Mince ginger & scallion
nodes.description: Fine-mince ginger; separate scallion whites from greens.

nodes.label: Mix sauce & slurry
nodes.description: Stock, soy sauce, sugar, and a cornstarch slurry, whisked together.

nodes.label: Boil salted water in pot
nodes.description: Bring salted water to a boil in a pot.

nodes.label: Blanch tofu
nodes.description: Blanch cubes in salted water 1-2 min to firm up and remove bean flavor.

nodes.label: Brown pork, then fry doubanjiang & aromatics
nodes.description: Brown the ground pork until crisp, then fry doubanjiang and fermented black beans until fragrant.

nodes.label: Combine & simmer
nodes.description: Add blanched tofu and sauce to the wok, simmer to let the tofu take on flavor.

nodes.label: Thicken & garnish
nodes.description: Reduce until glossy, fold in scallion greens and a drizzle of chili oil.

nodes.label: Plate & serve
nodes.description: Transfer to a serving dish while still bubbling; serve immediately over rice.
